# Andrius K. — Interactive Portrait Portfolio

> An interactive halftone portrait where each dot represents a life fragment — a project, thought, music piece, or personal moment.

## About
- Author: Andrius K.
- Site: https://andriusdesigner.com
- Type: Personal portfolio

## Content API
All portfolio entries (JSON): https://spring-snow-c3cc.andriusdesigner.workers.dev/

Each entry contains: title, category, year, body text, tags, images, and links.
Categories: Projects, Mind, Music, Design, Personal.

## Deep Links
Individual entries are accessible at: https://andriusdesigner.com/?dot={slug}
where {slug} is the entry title converted to lowercase kebab-case.
